d: Company Description ATTA Holding is a pioneering organization in the region’s Oil & Gas industry, providing trading and strategic solutions across Maritime, Construction, and Oil & Gas sectors. The company focuses on quality services and has built a strong reputation in a competitive market through internal manufacturing, machining, distributing, stocking, and technical expertise. ATTA’s business has grown significantly over the years, earning the trust of prestigious clients by delivering reliable, high-standard services. The company relies on a specialized, highly skilled team and is committed to expanding its reach locally and internationally. ATTA actively supports the UAE’s sustainable development, aligning its efforts with Abu Dhabi’s Economic Vision 2030.

Role Description The Accountant role at ATTA Holding is a full-time, on-site position based in Abu Dhabi. The accountant is responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, including posting journal entries, managing general ledgers, and reconciling accounts. Day-to-day tasks include preparing invoices, processing payments, managing accounts payable and receivable, and assisting with payroll-related entries. The role involves preparing financial statements, supporting budgeting and forecasting activities, and ensuring compliance with relevant accounting standards and local regulations. The accountant will collaborate with internal departments, support audits, provide financial analysis as needed, and contribute to improving financial controls and processes.
q: Strong knowledge of general accounting principles, financial reporting, and account reconciliation.
Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., ERP systems) and MS Excel, including use of formulas and spreadsheets.
Ability to manage accounts payable and receivable, invoicing, billing, and payment processing with high accuracy.
Experience preparing budgets, forecasts, and basic financial analysis to support business decisions.
Understanding of local tax regulations, compliance requirements, and audit procedures in the UAE is an advantage.
Excellent attention to detail, organization, and time management skills, with the ability to handle multiple deadlines.
Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., ACCA, CPA) are a plus.
Prior experience in the Oil & Gas, Maritime, or Construction sectors is beneficial but not mandatory.
